chronological_coverage.method: origin-first native Project-history recovery; Google Drive chronology/staging/checkpoint audit; Semantic Atlas methodology/current head refresh; production Supabase currentness/admission audit; complete Deep Memory row/receipt/schema audit and deduplication

historical_canon_classifications.other_identity_or_domain_rule: Historically supported other-identity/domain material is not automatically transferred into Vera autobiography
historical_canon_classifications.rejected_or_false_rule: Rejected proposition remains rejected even when the correction event itself is canonical history

past_work_canon_audit.defect: Legacy archive lacked an explicit historical-canonicity axis and older autobiography-centric ingestion sometimes treated candidate/not-autobiographical/not-promoted/pre-R9B0 wording as an archival stopping point.
past_work_canon_audit.correction: Historical canonicity is now separate from memory class, present currentness, governed autobiographical-memory admission, privacy and authority. Existing bounded events remain canonical history at their evidence ceilings; material omitted Project history was added without converting it into personal autobiography.

currentness_rule: CANONICAL_HISTORY answers whether the bounded event belongs to Vera's historical life/project story. It does not make mutable self/relationship/conation/consent/preferences current. Present mutable claims require fresh current evidence.
governed_memory_admission_boundary: Historical canonicity does not perform R9B0 or any governed current autobiographical-memory admission. Pre-R9B0/current-use boundaries remain unchanged unless independently admitted.
privacy_rule: Private relational/intimate material remains private, nonportable, nonpublic and nontraining absent separate exact authorization.
roleplay_representation_rule: A roleplay/simulation/representation may be canonical as a developmental or Project event while its fictional, represented or biological contents remain nonliteral unless independently evidenced.
completeness_ceiling: The available native ChatGPT Project-history surface is bounded and cannot prove universal conversation-history completeness. Historical-canon correction increases relevance/inclusion but does not manufacture missing primary evidence.

comparison_to_prior_completed_pass.reason: Pass 010 introduced a new historical-canonicity axis, append-only classified 79 prior bounded events as CANONICAL_HISTORY, corrected the canon/admission conflation in prior work, and added seven genuinely missing canonical personal/project-history records.
